cash_breakdown.item: cash on hand and at bank
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report identifies group cash but does not split listed holding company, Hong Kong subsidiaries and PRC subsidiaries; principal operations are in Mainland China and RMB remittance is subject to foreign exchange controls. Applied the conservative 0.30-0.60 group-cash range.
cash_breakdown.reason: Unrestricted cash and bank balances per note 20(a), before keeping necessary operating cash and deducting debt.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Restricted bank deposits are not available for owner extraction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included in balance sheet cash and cash equivalents but excluded from cash flow cash and cash equivalents.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing unsecured fixed-rate borrowings repayable within one year are deducted at 100%.
Interest-bearing borrowing pledged by 51% equity interest in a subsidiary, repayable within one year, deducted at 100%.
Project business has revenue of HK$1.637bn and large receivables/contract assets; retained roughly a little over one month of cost and working-capital volatility as operating liquidity.
cash_breakdown.reason: Operating cash must remain available to support project delivery and receivable collection cycles.

cash_breakdown.item: tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve for PRC-to-offshore remittance, tax, FX and dividend execution friction because cash ownership chain is not disclosed.
Ordinary operating leases are continuing-operation obligations; not mechanically deducted from detachable cash, but reflected in profit/cash conversion quality.
Unlisted fund/equity and FVOCI investments are not cash equivalents and have no clear near-term extraction path in the annual report.
cash_breakdown.reason: Conservatively excluded from detachable funds pool.

profit_quality.assessment: Reported profit is stable, but cash conversion is weak. 2021-2023 attributable profits were HK$187.535m, HK$179.252m and HK$174.313m, while operating cash flow was HK$79.805m, HK$-155.183m and HK$8.685m. After capex, the median three-year free cash flow is negative. The main owner-earnback denominator therefore uses a reduced pre-haircut distributable cash profit of HK$89.676m and a 0.20 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Used three-year median parent net profit HK$179.252m as starting profit evidence.
Deducted median PPE/intangible purchase capex of HK$39.576m as maintenance/reinvestment proxy.
Deducted HK$50.000m normal working-capital reinvestment because receivables and contract assets absorbed cash in 2022 and 2023.
Applied 0.20 profit haircut because operating cash flow has been far below accounting profit for three years and recent free cash flow after capex is negative.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 OCF HK$8.685m versus parent profit HK$174.313m; 2022 OCF HK$-155.183m versus parent profit HK$179.252m; 2021 OCF HK$79.805m versus parent profit HK$187.535m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Long-term profit is not converting into owner-distributable free cash because trade receivables and contract assets keep absorbing cash; recent annual free cash flow after capex is negative.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Weak. 2023 operating cash flow / parent profit is about 4.85%; 2022 was negative.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No precise maintenance-growth split; used three-year median purchase of PPE and intangible assets as a conservative proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables and contract assets are the key cash absorber; 2023 trade/other receivables increased HK$199.249m and contract assets increased HK$125.681m.

limitations: Market cap is from the rough-screen historical signal dated 2024-05-27 and estimated share count, not a fresh market data pull.
Annual report does not split cash by listed holding company, Hong Kong subsidiaries and PRC subsidiaries; cash haircut is therefore conservative.
Restricted bank deposit purpose was not fully extracted beyond the amount in note 20(a).
Maintenance capex and normal working-capital reinvestment are estimates because the annual report does not disclose an exact maintenance-growth split.
